Anika R: Postmortem follow-up from the midnight paging spike. Short plan: small, testable changes + owners.
Ben T: yes. avoid broad silences.
Anika R: Proposed steps:
1) quick threshold bump for top-8 noisy keys (trial 7 days)
2) per-service dedupe with signature + short suppression
3) scheduled maintenance-only suppression via job tags
Sofia G: I can own the dedupe impl. plan: consolidation 3m + suppression 20m for identical signature. signature = '{{service}}:{{key_pattern}}:{{op}}'. will test in staging.
Ben T: i'll run 45-day p95/p99 trends and propose cutoffs + expected page reduction. 48h turnaround.
Anika R: include false-negative risk note in PR. also add a short runbook blurb to alert defs.
alert-bot: (automated) Incident#4981 resolved by anika.r  follow-up task 'key-noise-mitigation' created
Sofia G: draft alert (staging):
```
alert: cache_key_cmd_p99
expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(cache_command_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, service, op, key_pattern)) > 0.5
for: 2m
labels:
  severity: paged
annotations:
  signature: "{{ $labels.service }}:{{ $labels.key_pattern }}:{{ $labels.op }}"
```
Anika R: owners & deadlines:
- Sofia G: dedupe + suppression PR + staging tests  due 2024-12-06
- Ben T: threshold analysis PR + dashboards  due 2024-12-05
- Anika R: canary plan + runbook update  due 2024-12-07
ops-tracker: (automated) Task created: key-noise-mitigation assigned to [Sofia G, Ben T, Anika R] due 2024-12-07
Ben T: suggestion: tag tuned alerts with label 'tuned-dec2024' and add a two-week banner in Slack notifications so oncall recognizes tuned values.
Sofia G: will add the label and ensure suppression respects deploy tags (whitelist).
Anika R: also starting a biweekly 3-alert sweep for 6 weeks post-rollout. volunteers?
Ben T: I'll take weeks 1 & 4.
Sofia G: i'll take weeks 2 & 5.
Anika R: please reply 'ack' when you've added cards to the project board and linked PRs here.
Ben T: ack - will post PR link.
